Hero.AboutMe: Frontend Developer specialized in React & Next.js, building modern web applications with clean UI and scalable backend systems.

AboutMeSection.AboutMeTextSectionOne: Frontend developer focused on developing modern, fast, and visually appealing web applications. I primarily work with React and Next.js, using them to build clean, responsive, and user-oriented interfaces.
AboutMeSection.AboutMeTextSectionTwo: While I specialize in frontend development, I also have experience working with backend technologies such as C# and .NET, which allows me to understand the complete architecture of modern web systems.
AboutMeSection.AboutMeTextSectionThree: I love turning ideas into real products, solving technical challenges, and continuously improving my skills through work on real-world applications and personal projects.
